text:
lucy: Quick heads-up: the runtime quickstart has an embedded Docker image link that returns 403 in staging (docs/quickstart/runtime.md -> https://artifacts.redwood-internal.com/runtime/quickstart-image.tar). Tried a preview and the extract step fails.

jerome: can you paste the curl output? might be a perms issue with the artifacts bucket.

lucy: yep:
```
$ curl -I https://artifacts.redwood-internal.com/runtime/quickstart-image.tar
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
x-request-id: zxy-789
```
I can still fetch the file from the internal console when I auth via SSO, so looks like a public/internal ACL mismatch.

rachel: hm ok. Is this blocking prod? or just staging previews?

lucy: staging previews for onboarding users. Not immediate prod critical but customers hitting the quickstart will be blocked if our CI publishes with that URL.

jerome: I'll raise a tiny infra ticket to re-evaluate the bucket policy. In parallel, would a docs PR that swaps to the stable CDN path be ok? e.g. `https://cdn.redwood.com/quickstart/runtime-image-v2.tar` — that one returned 200 for me.

rachel: go ahead and open a PR, include the original 403 evidence in the PR description. Backport to `translations/ja/quickstart/` too. Ping i18n owners for a quick translation sync.

docs-bot: Detected asset access error in quickstart. Created DOCS-4980. Suggested changelog: "fix: quickstart image URL (403 -> CDN path)"

jerome: PR incoming in ~20. I'll also add a short note in the changelog and add a test step to the CI smoke script: `curl -f` on the artifact URL.

lucy: nice. Please include the md5/hmac checksum line next to the link so CI can verify integrity.

jerome: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12567 — replaces the artifact URL, adds `sha256: 3a7bd3e2360a5f1f` and a smoke-test step in `.github/workflows/smoke.yml`. @rachel can you review?

rachel: Reviewing now. If it's a trivial URL + checksum + tiny workflow tweak I can approve. Also cc @i18n-team for ja backport.

lucy: thanks all — once merged I'll run the onboarding walkthrough and post results in the runbook.
